changes: Initial typed routing and middleware API for HTTP/1.1 applications behind a reverse proxy.
Mandatory libc-free io_uring server lifecycle with fixed, upfront runtime storage.
JSON, HTML templates, embedded and live static assets, gzip, and streaming multipart uploads.
